summary: Transport-level $batch failures are journaled as ambiguous; batch resume excludes them unless --include-ambiguous is passed.
reason: Priority may commit a chunk even when the response is lost; blindly replaying non-idempotent writes would double-execute them (Greptile P1 on PR #1623).
validated_outcome: resume of an ambiguous-only journal returns a verification note and replays nothing without the explicit flag.
